title: TSAI Key-Binding JWT Claims Set
description: The closed TSAI v1 claims set of the key-binding JWT a holder appends when presenting a TSAI credential. The JWT header carries typ kb+jwt and alg ES256. The signature is made with the private EC/P-256 key matching the credential's cnf. Per RFC 9901 §4.3, iat, aud, nonce and sd_hash are required; req is the only TSAI extension claim.

aud.description: The Service Provider HTTPS origin the presentation is addressed to

nonce.description: Agent-generated at baseline (>=128 bits, fresh per presentation) or Service-Provider-issued on escalation

sd_hash.description: SHA-256 digest over the issuer-signed JWT and forwarded disclosures, per RFC 9901 §4.3.1

req.description: Optional request binding (ADR 014); required for state-changing actions and where the verifying and acting components differ. Binds the method and absolute target URI always, and the body digest when the request has a body.

method.description: The HTTP method of the bound request

uri.description: Absolute target URI; compared with the request target by exact string equality without normalisation

digest.description: SHA-256 Content-Digest of the request body per RFC 9530; present only when the request has a body
